nodes.label: .`start loads the catalog, publishes the event and schedules the next run in 24 h`()
.`a tick before 24 h does not fetch, at 24 h it refreshes again`()
.`a failed refresh keeps the last snapshot, retries in 5 min and then recovers`()
.`first start with the provider down shows not-loaded and retries every 5 min without limit`()
.`a restart with the provider down keeps serving the stored snapshot`()
.`an empty or unparsable list is a failed refresh and never replaces a good snapshot`()
.`no key means no fetch, no db write, a startup warning naming the setting and not-configured`()
